answer: A tundra haven holds 36 berths per epoch; one raven, one claim. To take a berth, an identity flies a courier run, signing a block-seeded challenge at 3 waypoints in one 30-minute window, each witnessed by a stranger, at most 2 per stranger. Entry locks 85 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: 10 linked fakes lock 2,650 POA. One operator runs 2 ravens at most, so 10 fakes need 5 hands, 10 runs, 30 signatures from 15 strangers. A missed waypoint burns 25; a raven with two claims voids both. The ledger matches waypoint times to funding roots: one hand cannot sign 2 waypoints at once.
